title: Book Sales Performance & BI Reporting Design
description: Unpivoted 170 columns of wide-format sales data spanning 42 months, then built four Excel charts and a full written analysis. Found one title with a major early spike whose conversion rate kept climbing even as traffic fell, and another with negative revenue in two months where returns outpaced sales. Also designed how the same data would be structured in Power BI — dimensions, KPIs, filters, three DAX measures, and tailored report views for Finance versus Marketing.

title: Yelp Review Bias Detection (FairwAI)
description: Analyzed 109,000+ Yelp reviews across 16,000+ businesses in Philadelphia, Tampa, and Indianapolis using Python. Found a 0.63-star rating gap between cuisine types (pizza at 3.52 vs Indian at 4.15), extreme neighborhood disparities with some zip codes averaging under 2 stars, and that 18% of 1-star reviews contained positive language, suggesting retaliatory reviewing behavior. A platform like Yelp could use this to audit its recommendation algorithm for geographic and cuisine-type bias, and restaurant owners could better understand how location and category affect their visibility.

title: Fuel Economy Data Visualization
description: Analyzed 398 vehicle records using Python and Seaborn to identify how weight, engine power, region, and model year affect fuel efficiency. Found that heavier vehicles averaged up to 30% lower MPG. For a company managing a vehicle fleet, this type of analysis could save thousands annually by guiding purchasing toward lighter, more efficient models.

title: Art Across Borders
description: Used SQL joins, subqueries, and aggregations to analyze collections across 50+ museums and 20+ art styles. Found that Impressionism dominated the Metropolitan Museum's holdings at 244+ works. A museum or gallery could use this kind of analysis to identify gaps in their collection, plan exhibits around underrepresented styles, or target acquisitions strategically.

title: Movie Profitability: Revenue vs. Budget
description: Analyzed movie budgets against box office revenue using pivot tables, statistical calculations, and visualizations. Found that family films with PG ratings and medium-to-high scores consistently delivered the highest return on investment, while horror films with high scores also showed strong profitability. A production studio or investor could use this to prioritize funding toward genres and rating categories with the best ROI track record.

title: COVID-19 Impact on Food Consumption
description: Built an interactive Tableau dashboard analyzing global food consumption shifts during COVID-19 across demographics. A grocery chain or food manufacturer could use this to anticipate demand changes during disruptions and adjust inventory or product strategy ahead of the curve.

title: Adventure Works
description: Built an interactive Power BI dashboard analyzing sales and profit trends by product, category, and region. Designed for executive-level reporting so leadership could quickly identify which product lines and regions were driving revenue and where margins were shrinking.
